procedure.method: Independent review in this fresh session, without spawning, resuming, forking or consulting peer/producer/planner records. Verified the declared input hashes and byte counts. Read the pinned source manifest and all five pinned native-evidence manifests without following their unlisted embedded paths. The packet has no protected layouts. Actually opened the exact LAMP-FIXTURE source using view_image(detail=original), and inspected its returned image. Then actually opened and inspected all fifteen exact poster images using view_image(detail=original), with the returned images displayed through functions.exec/image: M1 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M2 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M3 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M4 native, usage720, thumbnail320; M5 native, usage720, thumbnail320. Completed that entire sequence before starting copy transcription or any image/set judgment or score. One source open and fifteen poster opens; no image revisits were needed. First readings were taken from those displayed native pixels after the complete viewing sequence, with usage and thumbnail observations retained separately. No OCR, generated crops, replacements or pixel edits were used. PNG headers and RGB modes were checked read-only: every native is opaque 1672x941, each usage view 720x405, each thumbnail 320x180. Native 16:9 conformity uses the predeclared single-edge rounding exception: abs(941-1672*9/16)=0.5, rather than mathematically exact aspect. Actual attachment use in the native calls is not established by the allowed manifests; visual source identity is assessable, and this provenance limitation remains explicit. No runtime session ID or synthetic opening/tool event is claimed.

residuals: The set has meaningful differences in photographic editing, print marks, scenic page placement and lighting, but not five fully independent whole styles. M2, M3 and M5 retain closely related hero/title/body/lower-information relationships.

Forest green, warm cream/amber light and a similar frontal three-quarter lamp view recur throughout; several members also reuse a book/paper still-life. These relationships limit diversity despite the different image treatments.
